bullets.text: SOLiD Targets Middleprise Connectivity - **SOLiD** launches BARS to provide scalable cellular solutions for under-served buildings.
5G Energy Efficiency Research - New studies reveal potential for 5% of global electricity use by mobile networks by 2030.
AI-Driven Cloud Investments - Telecom operators are rapidly increasing cloud spending to leverage **AI** for operational automation.
Samsung and SoftBank's 6G Collaboration - The two companies aim to advance **6G** and AI-driven RAN technologies.
ZTE Wins Indoor Connectivity Award - Recognized for its innovative **Full-Scenario Indoor Digitalization Solution** at Network X 2025.
Vodafone's AI for 5G Operations - **Vodafone** partners with Zinkworks to automate 5G network management using AI.
Open RAN Rollout in Germany - **Vodafone** collaborates with **Wind River** to deploy Open RAN across thousands of sites.
Agentic AI in Telecoms - Telcos are positioned to lead the AI economy, transforming customer interactions and service delivery.
MasOrange Achieves Merger Synergies - The company reports €259 million in synergies ahead of schedule post-merger.
